findings.evidence: Mathlib/GroupTheory/Commutator/Basic.lean:386 supplies commutator_prod_prod; Mathlib/GroupTheory/QuotientGroup/Basic.lean:87 and :166 supply prodMulEquiv and quotientMulEquivOfEq.
findings.fix: Use Subgroup.commutator_prod_prod specialized to top subgroups, transport with QuotientGroup.quotientMulEquivOfEq, then compose QuotientGroup.prodMulEquiv.
findings.issue: prodMulEquiv manually reconstructs the quotient-of-product equivalence, duplicating its inverse and quotient-induction proofs.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/GroupTheory/QuotientGroup/Basic.lean defines quotientKerEquivOfRightInverse; the new commutator_eq_zAxis (:240) and ker_projXY (:261) identify exactly its quotient domain.
findings.fix: Transport along commutator_eq_zAxis.trans ker_projXY.symm, then compose QuotientGroup.quotientKerEquivOfRightInverse projXY with the section v ↦ ⟨v.toAdd.1, v.toAdd.2, 0⟩.
findings.issue: abelianizationMulEquiv manually proves the first isomorphism theorem despite already establishing the required kernel equality.

summary: Two quotient equivalences duplicate existing Mathlib constructions instead of composing them.
